title: emit_campaign_content input, bilingual (strict variant sent to the model when the audience has English-speaking customers)
description: Strict-compatible variant of ../content.schema.json with the `en` block required (P8, D63). Same structure as content.tool.json plus `en`; no minLength. Length limits (after personalization) and template-variable rules are enforced only by the backend validator.

body.description: Plain-text SMS template. At most 160 Unicode characters after personalization. Allowed variables: {{first_name}}, {{last_name}}, {{city}}.

subject.description: Plain-text email subject template. At most 80 Unicode characters after personalization.

body.description: Plain-text email body template (no HTML; blank line = new paragraph). The backend renders it to escaped HTML. At most 5000 Unicode characters.

en.description: English version of the same message for English-speaking customers: same intent and tone, same limits, same variables. Not a word-for-word translation.
